title: The legacy of the Revolution: one party and land reform
goal: Say what was done after the Revolution, with the passive with *ser*.

items: I can say what was done, with *ser* + past participle.
I can say who founded the ruling party in 1929 and what became of it.
I can explain what Cárdenas did with land and oil.
I can use the words *el partido*, *repartir*, *expropiar* and *la estabilidad*.
